projects.name: Orbital Fabrication
projects.benefit: LOWER CORVETTE COST AND BUILD TIME
projects.description: Ceres yard crews developed jigs that let a single tug build and align a hull in free fall. Standardizing the design makes every new corvette cheaper and faster to produce.

projects.name: Fire Control
projects.description: Separate hulls can share a firing solution before their weapons open up. A synchronized track gives our escorts more time to shoot before reaching a convoy.

projects.name: Fleet Escort Systems
projects.description: The Mariner trades acceleration for armor, reactor capacity and a heavier battery. It can escort fragile expedition hulls through a contested arrival.

projects.name: Habitat Engineering
projects.benefit: BUILD O'NEILL HABITATS AND SUPPORT FUSION FLIGHTS
projects.description: Closed-loop water and air systems keep crews alive through long missions. The same design makes rotating habitats and their industrial capacity possible.

projects.name: Long Burn Drive
projects.description: A reworked heat rejection loop lets ships sustain a burn long enough to reach the outer worlds. The new drive also increases acceleration on local transfers.

projects.name: Deep Sky Astrometry
projects.benefit: CHART NEARBY STARS AND SCAN FASTER
projects.description: Combining long-baseline observations gives Sol a chart of nearby systems. It also improves the instruments on every survey scout.

projects.name: Pulsed Fusion
projects.benefit: IMPROVE SCOUT AND FLEET TRANSIT TIMES
projects.description: Long-duration fusion burns cut travel time along surveyed interstellar routes and unlock the long range drive package.

projects.name: Fleet Logistics
projects.description: Standardize hot-swappable machinery and resupply manifests. Fleet upkeep falls, at the expense of heavy extraction subsidies.

projects.name: Heavy Industry
projects.benefit: MORE ORE FROM EACH EXTRACTION SITE
projects.description: Dense processing plants improve mine and skimmer output. The alternative logistics subsidy is unavailable once this program begins.

projects.name: Precision Interferometry
projects.description: Dedicated interferometers improve precision and shorten a scout survey. Wide search arrays use the same production capacity.

projects.name: Wide Search Arrays
projects.benefit: EARN MORE ORE PER COMPLETED SURVEY
projects.description: Wide-band searches recover more salvage per complete survey. They trade precise sampling for wider coverage.

projects.name: Heavy Hull Frames
projects.description: A reinforced modular frame supports larger reactors and navigation packages. Integrate it at an orbital shipyard.

projects.name: Capital Hull Frames
projects.description: Parallel slips make very large hulls possible. Their costs and naval capacity requirements still apply.

projects.name: Long Range Gunnery
projects.description: Range-finding and fire-control software work together. Your electronics program cannot also develop advanced shield fields.

projects.name: Shield Harmonization
projects.description: Sustain a reinforced field at the cost of power and the long-range targeting program.

projects.name: Surface Engineering
projects.description: Improve extraction and observation at existing staffed colonies. Upgrades preserve the original structure slot.

projects.name: Orbital Engineering
projects.description: Upgrade labs, shipyards, power, and logistics platforms in place.

projects.name: Volatile Cold Traps
projects.benefit: +1 ore per producing body per cycle
projects.description: Cold fingers catch volatile feedstock before it escapes a warm separator. Crews recover the condensate at the end of each shift.

projects.name: Droplet Radiators
projects.description: A stream of cooling droplets carries heat away from the drive. Magnetic collectors return the droplets to the loop before the next burn.

projects.name: Vernier Clusters
projects.description: A ring of small attitude jets applies torque at both ends of the keel. Heavy hulls can turn their engines retrograde earlier.

projects.name: Stellar Occultation Survey
projects.description: Watch the brief dip as a minor body passes a background star. A better estimate of its size guides the sample tug.

projects.name: Parallel Assembly Slips
projects.description: Construct service trunks on a second slip while the yard lays down the keel. Queued orders retain their original estimates.

projects.name: Thermal Storage Banks
projects.description: Banks of phase-change salt absorb surplus energy during the sunlit portion of an orbit.

projects.name: Convoy Departure Windows
projects.benefit: Reduce fleet upkeep by 1 energy per cycle
projects.description: Coordinate resupply at shared departure windows. One tug can now serve several hulls before returning to berth.

projects.name: Solar Furnace Foils
projects.description: Segmented mirrors heat ore at the mine face. The refinery can now separate metal before loading the return tug.

projects.name: Mass Stream Sorting
projects.description: Charge identical grains and sort each stream by its curvature through an induction ring. Tailings become ballast for the return run.

projects.name: Pulsar Clock Array
projects.description: Pulse arrival times give detached scouts a common clock beyond the last relay.

projects.name: Swarm Parallax
projects.description: Pairs of collectors a million kilometres apart record the same occultation and triangulate buried ice.

projects.name: Heat Exchange Depots
projects.description: Docked ships exchange coolant with a common thermal reservoir during the night shift.
projects.benefit: Reduce upkeep by 1 energy per cycle

projects.name: Cycler Freight Tables
projects.description: Cargo crews rendezvous with regularly returning habitats. The long leg of the journey needs no dedicated transport.
projects.benefit: Reduce upkeep by 2 energy per cycle

projects.name: Closed-loop ecology
projects.description: Reclaim water, nutrients and air with redundant biological loops. Harsh settlements still need a local orbital habitat.

projects.name: Climate engineering
projects.description: Use orbital power and atmospheric processing to warm or cool marginal surfaces. Improvements take time and raise the settlement rating of the target body.

projects.name: Ion pulse shaping
projects.benefit: PULSE SHOTS GAIN RANGE AND ION TRACERS
projects.description: Use staged discharge to keep the pulse collimated through a long intercept.

projects.name: Radiator logistics
projects.description: Standardize coolant fittings so yards can service visiting ships without keeping a dedicated auxiliary loop online.

projects.name: Sparse baseline surveying
projects.description: Coordinate scout transponders across independent orbits to reject instrument drift.

projects.name: Closed slag reclamation
projects.description: Repeat the separation pass on tailings and save the dense fractions for orbital fabrication.

projects.name: Habitat segmentation
projects.benefit: REDUCE THE POWER LOAD OF HABITAT SUPPORT
projects.description: Pressure-isolated cells let a construction crew commission useful volume before closing the whole cylinder.

projects.name: Soletta engineering
projects.description: Build a segmented orbital reflector and a microwave relay to deliver power to the sites below. The mirrors require an inhabited construction base.

projects.name: Distributed aperture control
projects.description: Compare phased returns from escort ships spread across the local orbit before committing to a firing solution.

projects.name: Thermal bore telemetry
projects.description: Measure heat flow and map fractures before a bore commits its cutters.
